blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday passed on second reading a P7.2-trillion spending bill that would fund the government through next year. Lawmakers approved on second reading via voice vote House Bill No. 10858, the 7,408-page spending measure detailing a record national budget to fund state operations, government salaries, infrastructure projects and key social services for 2027. Though the timing of the vote means the House will miss its self-imposed Friday deadline for final passage due to a mandatory three-day cooling-off rule between legislation approval.
